title: gigai gig manifest (gig.toml), manifest format 1
description: Static manifest shipped as package data at <package>/gig.toml. Read by core through importlib.metadata distribution files; never requires importing the gig.

manifest_format.description: Format of this file. Core refuses unknown formats.

name.description: Command name: `gigai <name> ...`. Must equal the entry point name in group `gigai.gigs` and the `gigai-<name>` executable name, if any.

version.description: Optional. The distribution version (PEP 440) is the version of record; if present here `gigai gig check` requires equality.

description.description: One line, shown by `gigai gig list`.

core.description: PEP 440 specifier of the gigai core versions this gig runs on, e.g. ">=2,<3". Must agree with the `gigai` pin in the distribution's dependencies.

group.description: `module:attr` of the Click group mounted as `gigai <name>`. Same value as the entry point. Required unless `executable` is given.

executable.description: Out-of-process fallback: an executable on PATH that answers `describe` with this manifest as JSON and forwards every other verb.

provides.description: Verbs the gig implements itself, listed so `gigai gig info` can show them without importing. Core-provided verbs (status, doctor, config, export, import, eval) must not be listed; a gig may override them in code, which `gigai gig check` reports.

mode.description: mount = core imports `app` (WSGI/ASGI callable) and serves it under `mount_path` on the one gigai server. process = core supervises a child process started by `start` and reverse-proxies `mount_path` to it.

app.description: mount mode: `module:attr` of the app callable.

start.description: process mode: argv run by core; `{port}`, `{home}`, `{data}` are substituted.

port.description: process mode: preferred port; 0 = core picks a free one and passes it as {port}.

health.description: Path that returns 2xx when ready, relative to the gig's root (`/api/health` today for Scout).

mount_path.description: Where the gig's routes and UI appear on the core server.

ui.description: Package-relative directory of a built static UI served at `mount_path` (today `scout/ui/dist`).

bind.description: Declared need. `any` is what a container deploy needs; core policy decides whether to honour it.

python.description: Mirror of `requires-python`; `gigai gig check` requires equality.

name.description: Executable looked up on PATH by `doctor` and at install.

hint.description: What to tell the user when missing, e.g. `brew install typst`.

gigs.description: Other gigs that must be installed, with optional version specifier.

schema.description: Package-relative JSON Schema file validated against `<home>/gigs/<name>/config.toml` at install and before every command (B §4 item 7: jsonschema is already a core dependency).

defaults.description: Written to `<home>/gigs/<name>/config.toml` at install when the file is missing.

service.description: Key name in core's secrets catalog (today exa, openrouter, openai: `secrets_catalog.py:13-17`). Unknown names are added to the catalog by install, with `env`.

env.description: Environment variable the key is injected as for this gig's commands and server.

required.description: Required keys block `gigai <gig> run`; optional keys only show in `status`.

scopes.description: Informational: what the key is used for (`chat`, `web-search`, `embeddings`).

alias.description: Per-gig key alias: core resolves `<service>.<alias>` (e.g. a dedicated OpenRouter key with its own limit) before the shared `<service>` key.

spend_cap.description: A request. Core enforces what it can (call counters today, USD via a per-gig OpenRouter key limit per B §4 item 4); the effective cap is shown by `status`.

dirs.description: Folder names under the gig folder `<home>/gigs/<name>/`. Nothing is created at install; the gig folder itself is created on the gig's first run.

engine.description: sqlite = `ctx.store.db(gig, name)` opens the store at `<home>/gigs/<gig>/<name>.sqlite` (created on first open, nothing at install); the gig steps its `user_version` with `ctx.store.migrate(name, steps)`; dolt = [C: pending]; files = plain directory.

file.description: Not used by core: a sqlite store always lives at `<home>/gigs/<gig>/<name>.sqlite`.

migrations.description: Not applied by core at install: the gig applies its migrations at run time, on first open, with `ctx.store.migrate(name, steps)` (one `user_version` step per transaction).

rebuildable.description: True = a cache; excluded from export and from `doctor` integrity checks.

export.description: Globs (relative to the gig's data dir) included by `gigai <gig> export`; default = everything not `rebuildable`.

outside_home.description: Paths outside `<home>` the gig writes (declared for review; today Scout: `~/Documents/GigAI/{jobs,resumes}`).

page.description: Package-relative Markdown page shown by `gigai docs <name>` and listed in the hub UI.

cli_manual.description: Package-relative YAML/JSON with per-command prose in core's `commands.yaml` shape (A2 §1.3), merged by path prefix `<name>`.

evals.description: Design: gigai-jhf (research/gigai-evals SPIKE.md section 9). Declares the gig's model-call steps, their prompts, datasets, scorers and gates, so core records traces and runs `gigai <gig> eval ...`. Paths are package-relative unless they start with `{data}` (the gig folder `<home>/gigs/<gig>/`). `gigai gig check` item 11 checks it.

cluster.description: Default unit for every confidence interval and paired test: the item field whose equal values are not independent (Scout: `posting_sha`).

id.description: Stable step id used in traces and labels.

input_schema.description: Package-relative JSON Schema of the step input.

output_schema.description: Package-relative JSON Schema of the step output.

model_target.description: Name of the model target/role in config the step calls through core adapters.

dataset.description: Package- or data-relative reference to the gold/replay dataset (JSONL) for this step; the same as `datasets.release` given as a bare path.

file.description: Package-relative prompt template; core stamps its sha256 on every trace.

prompt.description: The step's prompt template: id, version and file.

postprocess.description: `module:attr` of the pure function turning a raw output into the typed object (replayable with no model call).

scorers.description: Code scorers: callables named `module:attr` (their signature is set by `eval run`), or `step:<id>` for a judge step of this manifest.

ci.description: Synthetic rows shipped in the package, pinned by sha256; run with 0 model calls. Its licence must be on the allow-list.

release.description: The small live suite (usually private, under `{data}`).

upgrade.description: The full suite a model change is measured on (usually private, under `{data}`).

gates.description: Named gates (`ci`, `release`, `upgrade`): which suite, how many calls, and the rules a run must meet.

grades.description: Judge steps: the step this judge grades, `<step>` in this manifest or `<gig>:<step>` in another gig.

dimension.description: Judge steps: the one dimension this judge grades.

against.description: What the judge is checked against (`labels`).

validation.description: Judge steps: the agreement a judge must show before `eval run` uses it.

steps.description: Generic per-step model binding any gig may declare, keyed by step id: the prompt file, the output schema and the adapter role (or target) `ctx.model(step_id)` resolves the step to.

prompt.description: Package-relative prompt file of the step.

schema.description: Package-relative JSON Schema of the step output.

role.description: Adapter role the step falls back to (a profile role: planner, critic, adjudicator, reviewer, verifier, researcher, gig_creator).

target.description: Model target the step is bound to; wins over `role`.

settings.description: Request settings every call of the step carries; the call's keyword arguments win. A claude/codex CLI target carries only `system` and `output_mode`, so any other setting refuses that target.

cap_usd.description: Per-click USD cap: a call whose worst-case estimate (input tokens x prompt price + max_output_tokens x completion price) is over it is refused before any adapter call. `steps set <step> --cap-usd` overrides it; `ctx.model(..., cap_usd=)` overrides both.

permissions.description: Declared for review and for `gigai gig info`; not enforced by core (B finding 6: no plugin ecosystem isolates; a container does).

network.description: Egress hosts or patterns the gig contacts.

filesystem.description: Paths outside `<home>/gigs/<name>` the gig reads or writes.

hooks.description: Optional Python callables imported only when the lifecycle step runs.

install.description: Run after core provisioned dirs/config/keys (Scout: today's `install_scout`, `scout/template.py:279-360`).

doctor.description: Returns extra doctor checks merged into `gigai <name> doctor`.

path.description: Package-relative JSONL, or `{data}/...` under the gig folder (private, never shipped).

source.description: Where the rows come from (`synthetic`, a URL, `operator labels`).

licence.description: SPDX id (allow-list: CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-SA-4.0, MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-3-Clause, ODC-By-1.0, CDLA-Permissive-2.0), or any licence / `private` for private data under `{data}` outside the `ci` suite.

slice_recipe.description: How the slice was cut: filter, stratification, count.

seed.description: The sampling seed of the slice.

min_ci_lower.description: Lowest allowed lower bound of the paired difference's confidence interval.

no_worse.description: Largest allowed drop of the point estimate (negative).

paired_to.description: The run this one is paired against (`previous-model`, `last-release`).

require.description: Scorers that must pass on every item, or named minimums.

snapshot.description: Package-relative replay snapshot the `ci` gate's numbers must equal.

registered_at.description: The day the gig fixed its base-run ladder and pass rules, before any base run.

ladder_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the shipped ladder the gig registered: `gigai/evals/ladder.toml` (v1) or `gigai/evals/ladder-v2.toml` (v2). `eval base` runs that ladder and refuses a pin that matches neither.

prereg.description: `release` gates: the pre-registration `gigai <gig> eval base` checks before it runs.
